pairs.subject: outbound-notifications
pairs.evidence: src/features/plugins/twin/sub_channels/ReplyOutbox.tsx:26 This context only stages an operator-approved reply and records it as an outbound communication row (ReplyOutbox.tsx:174 recordInteraction); nothing pushes events to an external channel. A search of twin/shared, twin/sub_channels and twin/__tests__ for webhook, dispatch, deliver and breaker found no hits, so the subject's precondition (pushing internal events out to user-configured sinks) does not hold here.

techniques.evidence: src/features/plugins/twin/sub_channels/ReplyOutbox.tsx:174 Approve writes a DB row through recordTwinInteraction. There is no adapter trait and no send that returns an outcome.

src/features/plugins/twin/sub_channels/useChannelActivity.ts:26 Staleness is worked out from logged activity timestamps, not from delivery-attempt outcomes. With no delivery attempts here, there is no per-sink ledger or breaker to judge.
src/features/plugins/twin/shared/channels.ts:57 This is a display and credential-matching palette for channel kinds. It has no event subscriptions or pattern matching.

src/features/plugins/twin/sub_channels/ContactThread.tsx:34 Inbound messages are pasted or picked by hand from logged rows to ground a draft. There is no poller, cursor or two-way bridge, so no echo loop is possible.
